verdict.comment: Busby and CITY ESCAPE both won over C&D last week. but the latter's success came in a stronger race so she is preferred.

comments.balqaa: 4lb below last winning mark, but she needs to better her last two performances.
comments.brinton: Off the mark in a 0-50 classified at Southwell last time; still has to prove her stamina
comments.busby: Won for the fifth time over C&D a week ago; this is tougher but he still commands respect
comments.cityescape: Recorded fourth C&D success six days ago; 3lb higher and every chance of going in again
comments.fascinatinglips: Dual Polytrack winner; needs to improve for the switch to blinkers on Tapeta debut
comments.foresthaze: Unplaced in all six starts; best watched for now
comments.indianromance: 0-8 and has shown little in either start for this yard; plenty more needed; hood returns
comments.princehector: 2-33 with both wins coming over C&D, but he ended last year quietly; off 84 days
comments.sirlaurencegraff: Narrowly beaten on Polytrack the last twice, but his record around here reads 07578

races.raceComment: cityescape is marginally preferred with a score of 48.6%, holding clear edges in more progressive and more reliable profile over busby. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The vote goes to dual C&D scorer AUTUMN ANGEL who is 2lb lower than when beaten a neck back here last Tuesday.

comments.autumnangel: Dual C&D winner around new year; 2lb lower than when beaten a neck last time; high on list
comments.backtomorrow: Completed a hat-trick over C&D in January, but this company is much tougher
comments.bazball: Had become disappointing but showed more when fourth last time; claims if building on that
comments.kensingtonagent: Won twice over C&D in 2023 and close fourth on return from a break here last time; player
comments.ladywingalong: Enjoyed the run of the race when winning last time; 3lb rise may leave her vulnerable
comments.rainyniteingeorgia: Dual Lingfield winner and 1lb lower than for the latest but attempts 6f for the first time
comments.rhythmicacclaim: Back off last winning mark, but 0-9 on AW and likely to need the run after five months off
comments.zepparella: 0-5 but beaten less than a length last time; still open to improvement

races.raceComment: ladywingalong is marginally preferred with a score of 59.1%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form and more progressive over autumnangel. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 10 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include improving, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged around tight left-handed polytrack

verdict.comment: The vote goes to NORDIC GLORY who finished third from the outside stall in a handicap here a fortnight ago and now drops in class.

comments.availableangel: Usually seen over further, but a close fourth over C&D last time; frame material again
comments.banana: Has often flattered to deceive and her record stands at 0-41; others safer
comments.dontfightit: Not beaten far in three of last five starts, but needs more on Tapeta for the first time
comments.gypsynation: Has yet to be placed in 17 starts so has enough to prove
comments.misscalculation: Ran well in first three starts after returning from a break, but a lesser effort last time
comments.nordicglory: Only managed to win one of his last 23 starts, but drops to this level for the first time
comments.peacheycarnehan: Nine wins here, but losing run up to 17 and not much sign of him turning things around
comments.secondcollection: Dual C&D winner who is favoured on these terms; considered
comments.starofatlantis: 1-1 at this level and ran well in a C&D handicap on stable debut last time; in the mix

races.raceComment: nordicglory is marginally preferred with a score of 49.8%, holding clear edges in more progressive over secondcollection. Placed in 4 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Despite being 6lb worse off with his old rival, the less-exposed COLLUSION can confirm January's C&D form with Alafdhal.

comments.alafdhal: Three wins here, the first two over 6f and the latest over 5f in January; thereabouts
comments.arlecchinosgift: Four wins over C&D and successful at Kempton last time; should make his presence felt
comments.collusion: Off the mark at the eighth attempt over C&D last time; another big effort seems likely
comments.eightmile: Makes his stable debut after five months off; market informative; hood on
comments.kento: 0-12 and well held on stable debut last month; needs to step up from that
comments.mightygurkha: Not the force of old; not beaten far the last twice but not easy to make a case for
comments.notjustyet: Record of 1-28 (0-14 on the AW) suggests that other are more compelling
comments.ramondiloria: 6lb below last winning mark, but latest efforts don't suggest he can take advantage
comments.romanemperor: Much better effort when beaten a neck at Kempton 12 days ago; shortlisted from same mark
comments.thismydream: 2lb below last winning mark, but is just 3-52; others make greater appeal

races.raceComment: alafdhal is marginally preferred with a score of 52.6%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over mightygurkha. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This can go to BURABACK who knows his way around here and will find this easier than when third in a Class 4 at Chelmsford last time.

comments.angleseylad: 0-11 and best watched now back from another five months off
comments.basholo: Last four wins have come over C&D and just beaten by a subsequent winner here last month
comments.beaumadier: 1-18 but ran well to finish second on stable debut at Lingfield last time; considered
comments.bernardspierpoint: Dual C&D winner; worth a market check on stable debut after four months off
comments.buraback: Four course wins; ran well in a much better race last time; interesting back at this level
comments.gustavgraves: Six wins here and likes to come late off a strong pace, but he needs things to fall right
comments.nelsongay: Three-time course winner whose latest run can be forgiven; capable at this level
comments.somenightmare: 6f course winner, but record suggests this first start in five months may be needed
comments.thedefiant: Losing run up to 18 and well behind Beaumadier at Lingfield last time
comments.wedgewood: Hasn't got home in her last two starts over C&D and races off the same mark

races.raceComment: wedgewood is marginally preferred with a score of 56.9%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more progressive and more reliable profile over nelsongay. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 15 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
